title: Ashbury Rewards Relocation Entitlement Schedule for Hotels
content:
When a hotel cannot honour a reservation and relocates the guest, Ashbury Rewards posts relocation compensation points according to the member's tier. This schedule states the tier's relocation compensation points and whether the entitlement is limited to guaranteed reservations.

## Entitlement by tier

| Tier | Relocation compensation points of the tier | Applies only to guaranteed reservations |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Member | 2500 | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite | 5000 | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 10000 | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | 15000 | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite | 20000 | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 25000 | Yes |

## Notes

- Every tier, including the base tier, has relocation compensation points; the figure rises by tier from 2500 at Ashbury Rewards Member to 25000 at Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite.
- At every tier the entitlement is limited to guaranteed reservations.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical members)

| Tier held | Relocation compensation points of the tier |
|---|---|
| Gold Elite | 10000 |
| Titanium Elite | 20000 |
| Member | 2500 |
